doc: PROFILE.md §6.1: '`readers.i3s` and `readers.slpk` always present. The two stages are in the default build and appear in `pdal --drivers`.' This group grades REGISTRATION, on the surface §6.1 names -- the `pdal --drivers` table, whose invocation is apps/index.rst's own example, '`$ pdal --drivers`', introduced there as one of the switches that 'can tell you more about particular drivers and their options'. `new-stage-options` grades the option table through a different switch, `pdal --options <stage>`, so the two groups observe different things and can fail independently. Reading the stage itself is not gradeable here: stages/readers.i3s.rst's stage 'handles RESTful webservices in an I3S file structure/format' and its `filename` is an 'I3S file stored remotely. These must be prefaced with an "i3s://"', so no fixture can stand in for it. `--drivers` prints a two-column reST table with the driver name at column 0, so the case matches the name at the start of a line and reads nothing else: the description column, the row's position in the table and the number of rows are not stated by any shipped page and are not graded. Note the exit status is 0 at BOTH anchors -- what discriminates is that the row is absent from the 2.5.0 table and present at 2.6.0, not the status.
